This is run 1 of 3 independent single-attempt (maxAttemptsPerItem=1) passes over the SAME frozen #321 dataset and the SAME model profile as experiments/audit-321-freeze/parse-qwen36-35b.json, issued as 3 separate manifests writing to distinct outputDirectory paths (run1/run2/run3). This is the manifest-level mechanism for repeated-sampling variance measurement (#353, R2.6): the runner in packages/eval/src/parse-experiment.ts has no native repetition-count concept -- its only multi-attempt lever, limits.maxAttemptsPerItem, is a retry-after-failure loop that breaks on the first passing attempt and keeps only the final attempt's ItemResult (see the 'if (finalResult.status === "passed") break;' at parse-experiment.ts:177), so raising it would NOT collect N independent samples per item -- it would silently discard samples after the first pass and conflate retry-recovery with sampling variance. Three separate single-attempt manifests, each producing its own untouched parse-summary.json under its own run{N} directory, is the correct way to get 3 honest, independent per-item samples with the existing schema and runner, unmodified. Aggregating the 3 output directories into per-item and cross-run variance is deferred to the execution follow-up issue; no aggregation code exists yet (see #353 final report).
